name: Soot pet
description: Create a new Soot pet with Codex imagegen: check Codex, prepare jobs, inspect progress and assemble sprites.

skills.name: soot-create-pet
skills.description: Create a new Soot pet or accessory variant using Codex imagegen handoff, seven animated states, sprite assembly and visual review.

tools.name: pet_preflight
tools.description: Check whether Codex CLI is installed and logged in on the Soot host. Returns user-facing setup steps; does not log in or generate images. Call before starting pet creation.

tools.name: pet_prepare
tools.description: Check Codex login, then prepare seven grounded imagegen jobs. Returns blocked onboarding steps without creating files when Codex is unavailable or signed out.

id.description: Stable pet job id; a changed brief requires a new id

accessories.description: Exact held object and worn accessories; replace the reference prop

action.description: Restrained hand interaction with the new object

reference.description: Optional image path relative to host-bound SOOT_PET_STORE; defaults to bundled Soot identity

tools.name: pet_inspect
tools.description: List supplied and missing state sheets for a prepared pet.

id.description: Stable pet job id; a changed brief requires a new id

tools.name: pet_assemble
tools.description: Pack seven generated PNG sheets into a Soot v3 atlas, state sheets and motion previews; visual review remains required.

id.description: Stable pet job id; a changed brief requires a new id

SOOT_PET_STORE.title: Kho pet
SOOT_PET_STORE.description: Đường dẫn tuyệt đối tới thư mục lưu tiến độ và ảnh của pet đang tạo. Người vận hành tạo thư mục này trước.
